records.source: Minimum plaque area in square pixels of the input image or detected well crop. Objects smaller than this value are discarded. 0 keeps small objects; other segmentation filters still apply. Fractional values are accepted. Default 0.
records.translation: Minsta plackarea i kvadratpixlar i indatabilden eller det identifierade brunnsutsnittet. Objekt som är mindre än detta värde tas bort. 0 behåller små objekt; övriga segmenteringsfilter gäller fortfarande. Decimaltal accepteras. Standardvärde 0.

records.key: Choose how to preview {name}. Figure mode finds wells; Plaque mode segments the images directly.
records.source: Choose how to preview {name}. Figure mode finds wells; Plaque mode segments the images directly.
records.translation: Välj hur {name} ska förhandsvisas. Läget Figure hittar brunnar; läget Plaque segmenterar bilderna direkt.

records.key: Plaque Assay reads plaque images (JPG, PNG, TIFF, GIF, BMP or WebP), a folder of them, or a paper's PDF.
records.source: Plaque Assay reads plaque images (JPG, PNG, TIFF, GIF, BMP or WebP), a folder of them, or a paper's PDF.
records.translation: Plaque Assay läser plackbilder (JPG, PNG, TIFF, GIF, BMP eller WebP), en mapp med sådana bilder eller en PDF-fil från en artikel.

review_method: AI technical authoring and independent AI language/technical peer review against exact source bindings; no human or native-speaker signoff.
